description: Describe the PostgreSQL query execution plan for a SQL statement by running EXPLAIN in the database

branchId.description: Optional ID of the branch to explain against; when omitted, the project's default branch is used.

databaseName.description: Optional name of the database to explain against; when omitted, the project's default database is used.

projectId.description: ID of the Neon project that owns the database.

sql.description: The SQL statement whose PostgreSQL execution plan to return, run under EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, FORMAT JSON).

name: explain_sql_statement
